ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle attachment zone.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black mass with feathered/mottled margins extending medially into both lobes; high-intensity white fields occupy the lateral lobe regions; distinct dark focal spot on the lower-mid left lobe and dark pigmentation at the distal right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and high vertical depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration map extracted along the entire trailing edge, exhibiting an irregular jagged boundary with localized deeper indentations on the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted from the median notch to mid-lobe, transitioning into a slight concavity/taper at the posterior-lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized detection of small dark circular clusters on the distal margin of the right lobe and a singular high-contrast dark spot at coordinates corresponding to the lower-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of five distinct, parallel, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity and high-contrast brownish-orange pixel clusters at the far distal tip of the left lobe, indicating physical trauma or colonization by external organisms.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced morphological asymmetry between lobe tips, with the left tip showing a more fragmented and eroded pixel boundary compared to the right.
